urls.hdx_crosswalk_source: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tha (resource tha_admin_boundaries.xlsx, sheet tha_admin2 — OCHA Common Operational Dataset admin2 pcode/name table, used ONLY to build the amphoe_code<->name crosswalk, not as a drought source)

meta.publisher: สำนักงานเศรษฐกิจการเกษตร (OAE — Office of Agricultural Economics), published via data.go.th / catalog.oae.go.th, dataset 'ai-drought-warning' / ดัชนีภัยแล้ง SPEI รายอำเภอ (SPEI drought index by amphoe/district)
meta.vintage: 2026-06 (June 2569 BE) — the CURRENT/latest month exposed by the dashboard's per-amphoe map layer at the time of pull
meta.label: MODELLED index, not a raw meteorological observation and not a disaster declaration. SPEI (Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index) computed by OAE from ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated reanalysis climate data (ECMWF Climate Reanalysis, served via Google Earth Engine Data Catalog) — i.e. MODELLED/derived from measured global reanalysis precipitation + temperature, aggregated to a monthly mean per amphoe (Thai district). This IS the exact 'OAE SPEI by district' product the user named: OAE is the publisher of record on data.go.th, and the metric is genuinely SPEI, genuinely at amphoe resolution, genuinely dated. It is NOT: (a) a Thai ground-station-only product (the underlying grid is a global reanalysis, downscaled/aggregated to district polygons — so treat as MODELLED, same provenance tier as the pipeline's existing HDX rainfall proxy, one step more official since OAE is the compiling government agency), (b) a DDPM drought-disaster declaration (no administrative/legal weight), (c) a multi-month per-district history (see gaps below).
meta.join_strategy_notes: Join key delivered here is 'amphoe_code' in the standard Thai 4-digit changwat+amphoe numeric scheme (province 2-digit + amphoe 2-digit order, prefixed 'TH', e.g. TH1001 = Bangkok/Phra Nakhon). This EXACT scheme matches OCHA's adm2_pcode used in the HDX 'cod-ab-tha' Common Operational Dataset (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tha), which was pulled ONLY to resolve amphoe_code -> English/Thai name + province (source-data/raw/drought-district/tha_admin_boundaries.xlsx, sheet tha_admin2). Each district row here already carries that resolved name_en/name_th/province_en/province_th plus a pre-computed match against source-data/th_amphoe.geojson's 'shapeName' property (the field build_amphoe.py/build_province.py join on). RESULT: all 928 SPEI rows found a normalized shapeName match (928/928) — th_amphoe.geojson has exactly 928 ADM2 features, same as this dataset. CAVEAT: th_amphoe.geojson carries NO province attribute, and 8 amphoe names repeat across different provinces (e.g. 5 separate provinces each have a district named 'Chaloem Phra Kiat') — those ~19 features (flagged 'ambiguous': true above, codes listed in coverage.ambiguous_amphoe_codes) cannot be safely joined by name alone. RECOMMENDED for a production build_*.py: prefer a spatial join (centroid-in-polygon or largest-area-overlap) between th_amphoe.geojson polygons and the HDX cod-ab-tha ADM2 polygons (tha_admin_boundaries.geojson.zip, NOT pulled in this pass — only the attribute .xlsx was downloaded) so amphoe_code transfers onto th_amphoe.geojson features unambiguously via geometry rather than name string matching; fall back to name+province matching only where a supplementary province field is added to th_amphoe.geojson.
gaps: Only a SINGLE current-month snapshot (2026-06) was extracted per district. The dashboard also shows a NATIONAL (whole-country aggregate, not per-district) monthly SPEI time series from 2015-01 to 2026-06 — that history was NOT captured here because the district breakdown map only exposes the latest month's value (measure 'LastSPEI'), not a per-district-per-month panel. A true per-district monthly panel would need either a different query against the same PowerBI backend (untested — the underlying dataset likely supports it, since the map is presumably re-querying the same 'spei_sheet' fact table filtered per month) or a bulk data request to OAE.

This data was NOT obtained via a documented public API or downloadable file. The dataset's ONLY listed resource on data.go.th/catalog.oae.go.th is a Microsoft Power BI 'publish to web' embed (format='URL'), which has no CSV/XLSX export. This JSON was reconstructed by loading the dashboard in a real browser and reading the underlying PowerBI 'querydata' XHR response feeding the district map visual (entity 'amphoe_sheet', measures 'LastSPEI'/'SPEI_Title') — see source-data/raw/drought-district/oae_spei_amphoe_powerbi_response.json for the raw captured response this file was parsed from. This is undocumented/unstable: OAE could change the report's internal visual structure at any time without notice, unlike a stable public API.

5 districts (TH2008 Ko Si Chang, TH2306 Ko Kut, TH8202 Ko Yao, TH8405 Ko Pha-Ngan, TH9008 Krasae Sin) return an exact 0.0 SPEI, which does not look like a genuine reading (4 of 5 are small island districts likely falling outside the ERA5-Land land grid mask) — treat these 5 as MISSING/gap, not as 'no drought'.

No independent DDPM (Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation) drought-declaration list was found as a single national dataset on data.go.th — only ~40 separate PER-PROVINCE 'สำนักงานจังหวัด' offices publish their own drought-affected-area/household CSVs with inconsistent schemas and no common amphoe code, so that MEASURED-binary-signal option from the task brief was not pursued further within scope; the OAE SPEI product above was judged the stronger, single, nationally consistent, more clearly official match to the user's literal 'OAE SPEI drought by district' ask.
meta.parse_notes: Parsed from the PowerBI DSR (DataShapeResult) v2 rowset in oae_spei_amphoe_powerbi_response.json: results[0].result.data.dsr.DS[0].PH[0].DM0 is a list of {S:[...], G0: <amphoe_code>, X:[{C:[<amphoe_code_dict_index_or_literal>, <spei_value>]}]} entries; in this particular response every row carried an explicit 2-element ['<code>', <value>] pair (no DSR run-length/dictionary compression kicked in across the 928 rows), so extraction was a direct walk of the PH[0].DM0 list. The dataset title 'SPEI_Title' measure resolved to 'SPEI เฉลี่ยรายอำเภอ มิถุนายน 2569' (SPEI average by amphoe, June 2026) confirming both the vintage and the district (not tambon/province) resolution.
